* '''Original''' ([[Evacuate? (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “Use 1 Force to target your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

USED: During any move phase, take target into hand.
